messages:
Marisol (AE): Hey team — MediStream just asked for the POC compliance bundle. They specifically want: SOC2 cert, pen-test letter, and access for a short-term SFTP drop. Any objections to sharing the staging creds?
Ethan (Solutions Eng): I can pull the SOC2 PDF and pen-test attestation. For SFTP we usually create a one-time scoped account and expire after 7 days. Is that acceptable? :+1:
Marisol (AE): 7 days is fine but they asked about KMS usage for staging keys — they want to run a small integration test that hits an encrypted store. Can we provide a mock KMS flow or temporary key material?
Ethan (Solutions Eng): We don't hand over KMS master keys. Options: give them an IAM-limited service account that can encrypt/decrypt specific test objects, or provide a flow that proxies requests through our staging endpoint (no key export). Which does MediStream prefer?
Marisol (AE): Asked them — they prefer to run a short end-to-end where their connector encrypts locally then we decrypt in staging. Would that work?
Priya (Security): We can support that if the account is scoped and we log all calls. Need PO and signed NDA first. Also: MediStream asked whether our pen-test letter must be the original or if a signed PDF copy is OK — answer is signed PDF is fine as long as the signature line and date are present.
Marisol (AE): Noted. Jordan — can you queue the NDA + PO request to procurement?
Jordan (SalesOps): On it. Will ping MediStream legal and add the PO template. ETA: today EOD.
Ethan (Solutions Eng): For the SFTP drop I can create the account and share host/creds via secure link. devops-bot will create a short-lived S3 presigned URL if they'd rather avoid SFTP.
devops-bot: Reminder: automated artifact share policy -> presigned URLs expire in 72h by default. Use `/artifact-share --ttl 7d` to request extension; include reason.
Marisol (AE): Great — we'll ask them which method they prefer. Priya, what artifacts exactly should I include in the evidence bundle?
Priya (Security): Minimum: SOC2 Type II report (PDF), latest penetration test letter (signed PDF), vulnerability scan summary (last 90 days), architecture diagram of staging (redacted network ranges allowed), list of subprocessors, and the POC access runbook (steps, TTL, contact). If they request encryption proofs, include KMS key policy snippets (redact ARNs).
Ethan (Solutions Eng): I'll attach sample runbook snippet below when I create the account:
```
# POC SFTP runbook (snippet)
1) create user redwood-poc-medi: chpasswd, set home, chown
2) restrict sftpd_config: AllowUsers redwood-poc-medi
3) scp dropped_files -> processing-bucket (tag: poc-medi)
4) expire user in 7d: usermod -e YYYY-MM-DD
```
Marisol (AE): Perfect. I'll wait for PO + NDA then kick off the bundle upload. One question from MediStream: Do we charge for a dedicated POC capacity if they want sustained throughput during the trial? Pricing detail needed.
Jordan (SalesOps): For short trials (<14 days) we usually include up to 50k tokens/day free for evaluation. Anything beyond that we propose a temporary dedicated quota with pro-rated commit. I can draft a simple quote and approval path.
Marisol (AE): Thanks. I'll hold off until legal confirms NDA. Priya — please flag if any of the artifacts are sensitive and need additional redaction before upload.
Priya (Security): Will review the SOC2 for any org-identifying details that conflict with our disclosure policy. If redaction needed, I'll mark the version and attach a redaction summary.
Marisol (AE): Awesome. I'll update thread when I hear back from MediStream on SFTP vs presigned URL and share the PO when ready. :rocket:
